title: Tanium security advisory (AV26-935)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-935 Date: September 17, 2026 As of September 16, 2026, Tanium is affected by a vulnerability in the following product: Threat Response Prior to Update 15 (v4.12.317) Prior to Update 8 (v4.17.289) Prior to Update 25 (v4.9.447) The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
